patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast black and white photography and video are used as impactful section backgrounds, often with white text overlays for a luxurious, editorial feel.

A sophisticated, elegant serif font is prominently used for the brand logo and key display headings, creating a strong brand identity, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and functional elements.

A predominantly monochromatic palette of black, white, and various shades of grey establishes a refined and premium aesthetic, with a single deep teal accent color (#00838f) used sparingly for interactive elements like calls to action.

The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text, creating a sense of depth, while the main navigation bar sticks to the top and a promotional banner slides in from above on scroll.
Content is structured with large, full-width hero sections featuring immersive imagery, followed by clean product grids and editorial-style text blocks, often paired with large-scale photography.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background with white text overlaid, ensuring high contrast and readability. The video is likely controlled via the 'video-hero' tech.
Scrolling down triggers a parallax effect on the hero content, where the background image moves at a different speed than the foreground text, enhancing visual depth.
The main navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after a short scroll, and a promotional banner slides down from the top, pushing the sticky nav into its final position.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings and logo (~4-5x body) with generous letter-spacing, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text, creating a sophisticated and airy feel.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly sharp corners on all elements and imagery, reinforcing a clean and modern aesthetic).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical and horizontal spacing, particularly in hero sections and between content blocks, allowing elements to breathe and enhancing the luxurious feel).

standout: The site's distinctive use of large-scale, high-contrast black and white photography and video as full-bleed section backgrounds, combined with a sophisticated serif display font for branding, creates an exceptionally luxurious and editorial feel that elevates the product beyond typical e-commerce.
